## 简体中文

- 删除客户端和服务端内网访问设置中的整份 JSONC 编辑入口，保留表单配置和 WireGuard 配置导入，并修正指向已删除入口的错误提示。
- 手动服务器中的配置集节点改为表格，左侧提供勾选、全选和拖拽排序；已选节点按表格顺序保存，客户端页面和服务端弹窗使用相同交互。

## English

- Remove whole-document JSONC editing from private access settings in the client and server. Keep the structured form and WireGuard configuration import, and update error messages that referenced the removed editor.
- Replace the configured-node selector under manual servers with a table supporting selection, select-all, and drag sorting on the left. Save selected nodes in table order, with the same interaction in the client page and server dialog.
